[Verse 1]
[D#5]Graze the skin with my
finger tips
The brush of dead cold flesh
pacifies the means
Provocative images delicate
features so smooth
A pleasant fragrance in the
light of the moon

[Chorus]
[D#5]Dance with the dead in my dreams
Listen to their hallowed screams
The
dead have taken my
soul Temp-
tation's lost all control

[Verse 2]
[D#5]Simple smiles elude
psychotic eyes
Lose all mind control
rationale declines
Empty eyes enslave
the creations
Of placid faces and life
less pageants

[Interlude]
[D#5]
In the depths of a mind
insane
Fantasy and rea
lity are the same

[D#5]

[Intro Riff]

[D#5]Graze the skin with my
finger tips

pacifies the means

on my being
Adulating the skin
before me
